description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail or critically fail a saving throw or skill check at the same time that an ally within 30 feet succeeds or critically succeeds at the same save or check.

You, like many atraxids, are highly competitive, and you can't stand to see one of your friends succeeding while you are failing. Reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.
